3 خاشنهُ , (S, M, K,) inf. n. مُخَاشَنَةٌ, (TA,) (assumed tropical:) He was rough, harsh, or coarse, to him; syn. عَلَيْهِ ↓ خَشُنَ ; in speech, and in action; (M, TA;)
[he acted towards him, or with him, roughly, harshly, or coarsely;] contr. of لَايَنَهُ. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
